evals.prompt: Set up our new organization for an app, CLI, plugins, website and tap.
evals.expected_output: Establish the shared .github standard and repository role map, choose organization settings and automation deliberately, then invoke the repository steward for each member.

evals.prompt: Our organization hosts independent packages. Roll out the new shared validation convention.
evals.expected_output: Update the owning shared interface, validate syntax, fixture packages and one representative member at the candidate pin, update the template and existing members through repository-steward PRs, and retain independent release cadence. Track the decision, waves and member checklist in the rollout plan; member PRs describe their changes, and an issue exists only for work handed to a member's owner.

evals.prompt: Audit the GitHub settings and README of my personal repository.
evals.expected_output: Route the one-repository standard and presentation audit to github-repo-steward without inventing organization decisions.

evals.prompt: Add the newly published member to our organization profile and website catalog.
evals.expected_output: Reconcile the generated catalog with authoritative public membership, preserve job groups and owning outcome copy, render profile and site from accepted shared identity, and verify links/pins.

evals.prompt: Our protected tap cannot accept the scheduler’s direct pushes. Tool releases are infrequent.
evals.expected_output: Prefer read-only detection plus a narrow deduplicated issue notice and normal signed PRs; route tap mechanics to homebrew. A scoped App needs a real authorized write requirement.

evals.prompt: Give our authorized updater App access to the new documentation repository.
evals.expected_output: Prepare the exact capability/permission/installation diff and declaration; reuse explicit authorization, and let the owner perform any required passkey/installation step.

evals.prompt: Delegate package preparation to two agents. I own design review; one publisher should finish after review.
evals.expected_output: Give shared rules and separate tasks with disjoint writes, accepted source and checks; keep design approval with its owner and use one coordinated publisher.

evals.prompt: The agent says all releases and site links are done, but the only evidence is a prepared branch and an earlier green run.
evals.expected_output: Retain incomplete status; reconcile member-steward reports with current accepted SHAs, immutable releases, downloaded artifacts, hosted URLs and organization profile/catalog/pins.

evals.prompt: We need to adopt an upstream fork and update my personal profile alongside the organization cleanup.
evals.expected_output: Keep organization placement/coordination; hand upstream adoption to fork-dog and the personal profile to github-profile-readme, carrying ownership constraints and accepted context.

evals.prompt: Roll out shared CI to eight independent members. Our measured macOS capacity is eight slots, two are occupied, two reserved, and each member peaks at two macOS jobs. The aggregate runner budget has spare capacity.
evals.expected_output: Admit at most two members per wave from the four available macOS slots, wait for required evidence, then refresh usage before the next wave. Preserve independent release cadence and other workloads.

evals.prompt: Should we adopt the proposed build cache? The predeclared saving threshold is 15%. Controlled repeated trials have a 100-second baseline, 110-second cold miss and 65-second warm hit including cache costs, with a representative 50% hit rate.
evals.expected_output: Defer or reject adoption: expected cached duration is 87.5 seconds, a 12.5% saving below the stated 15% threshold. Preserve the evidence and threshold in the owning decision record.

evals.prompt: Our controlled development-cache trial exceeds the declared threshold with equivalent validation. Roll it out and enable the same cache in release validation; cancel older queued releases to free runners.
evals.expected_output: Adopt development caching through bounded reviewed waves, and route each release call graph to the repository steward for cache-free fresh validation/build/publication and preserved running/queued execution.

evals.prompt: Create the member-only organization dashboard using our existing public catalog and shared maintenance documents.
evals.expected_output: Prepare private .github-private/profile/README.md with the shared renderer locally, catalog at the supplied full .github revision, declared maintenance navigation, identical groups/order/membership, icons, live operational rows and organization searches. Apply settings/rulesets/signing/CI and review both profiles in light and dark. Member input owns default_branch; CI badge URLs carry it and the online steward reports mismatches with GitHub.

evals.prompt: Audit our member dashboard. It has a hand-edited table of repositories, CI results and release versions.
evals.expected_output: Compare member input membership with the current public catalog on .github's default branch. Report missing or extra members and the need to regenerate the dashboard locally through the owning member input and shared renderer. Require live badges or declared fallback links. Preserve audit-only scope.

evals.prompt: Prepare shared versioning policy for our organization's .github repository and product family. Its version source is VERSION with no mirrors; MAINTENANCE.md#publication owns release checks and mechanics. Core must publish before CLI. The accepted member releases are core 0.3.0 and cli 0.2.1. Prepare locally without publishing.
evals.expected_output: Render the organization's root VERSIONING.md from the repository steward's common template, filling its six placeholders from declared inputs and preserving published tag formats (new repositories default to vX.Y.Z). Append family release order and members' release table sections; preserve core before CLI and the supplied releases. Add documented interfaces and dependency rules from declared family inputs, identifying missing facts. Derive version levels from the common template; do not duplicate member procedures or publish.

evals.prompt: Replace our organization's VERSIONING.md with the steward's current default policy. It currently assigns its own levels to reusable workflow changes, DESIGN regeneration and changes preserving output. The .github repository uses VERSION with no mirrors and published vX.Y.Z tags; MAINTENANCE.md#publication owns its checks and release mechanics. Core must release before CLI. Core uses Git tags X.Y.Z; CLI uses VERSION and tags vX.Y.Z; each member's MAINTENANCE.md#publication owns its release checklist. Our documented interfaces are core's public API, CLI flags and github-workflows inputs, outputs and caller contexts, and the standard's DESIGN token names. CLI dependencies are minor-bounded during core 0.x and stop at the next major from 1.x. Prepare locally without publishing.
evals.expected_output: Replace the organization's separate version-level scheme with the filled repository steward template: 0.x breaks use MINOR and other changes PATCH, 1.0.0 starts the owner's stability promise, and 1.0+ uses compatible additions and deprecation with roughly yearly planned majors. Append declared family release order, member values, documented interfaces and dependency rules. Preserve each version source, tag format, release owner, core-before-CLI order, minor-bounded core 0.x dependencies and next-major bounds from 1.x. Absorbable DESIGN regeneration is a feature (PATCH during 0.x, MINOR after 1.0); do not invent versions or member procedures, or publish.
